visualCharacteristics: Generic flex columns (columns-N-cols, image columns flagged columns-img-col) with Jackson typography: 20px/30px paragraphs, lists with red bullets, 20px accent arrow CTA. In a light or grey section: text column (605px) inset 55px and an image column (645x536) inset 35px from the panel edges; on mobile text first, then the image full panel width at the bottom.
contentPattern: One row; one cell per column. Text cell: heading, paragraph, list, bold+italic link. Image cell: a single image.

usage.description: Text and image feature sections, e.g. 'Can an annuity help you reach your goals?' inside a section styled light.

reuseGuidance: For the panel layout use two columns (text, image) in a light or grey section. Other column counts and sections keep the generic layout.
